# Bid the grind, the flake, and the drive.

> Price an epoxy or polyaspartic garage floor from grind hours, flake load, waste, cracks, and travel — not a $4/sq ft special. See kit cost, walk-away price, and whether a proposed number loses money.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
